name: Anjaneri Fort
description: Anjaneri Fort is a scenic hill fort near Trimbakeshwar, traditionally believed to be the birthplace of Lord Hanuman. The trek is relatively easy and passes through plateaus, forest trails, and temple complexes, offering panoramic views of the Brahmagiri range and Nashik valley.

routes.name: Anjaneri Village Route (Main)
routes.description: A gradual climb through forest patches and open plateaus with steps and well-defined trails.

landmarks.name: Anjani Mata Temple
landmarks.description: Temple dedicated to Anjani Mata, mother of Lord Hanuman.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Religious importance linked to Hanuman's birthplace.

landmarks.name: Hanuman Birthplace Point
landmarks.description: Sacred location believed to be birthplace of Lord Hanuman.

landmarks.name: Fort Plateau
landmarks.description: Wide plateau with scenic views of Brahmagiri hills.

history.brief: Anjaneri Fort holds mythological importance as the birthplace of Lord Hanuman and was later used during the Maratha period.
history.significance: Combination of religious and historical importance.
